label: The specified candidate is CONCRETE_6 and exists at the selected world, from borne thought
description: The selected being bears an occurring thought episode (OPEN); every bearer of an occurring thought is concrete (OPEN) and exists at w (OPEN); hence the selected being is an actual concretum at w.
